query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T10:25:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:55:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*pty*" OR message LIKE "*PTY*" OR message LIKE "*tty*")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC
